doc.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021

title: Ear-training the Astral Traveling chords
summary: Rowe tries the chords of Astral Traveling on keyboard and Smith corrects them.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: That’s a great story. So this morning I was doing a little ear training.
I put on “Astral Traveling” and so you’re going to tell me if I got anything close here. I’ve got a little keyboard here.
So is that anything like the chord you played?
Right. You’re playing an F with an F sus we call it.
That’s right. That’s right. Now I was hoping to get the next chord. Is it [strikes chord]
And then — the first is F sus then the second one is F minor, and back to the F sus, then a D flat major 7.
